pathAssistantSteps.info: PSA fully executed. Record the execution date and hand off to the transaction team to open escrow.
Prepare and review the PSA internally. Validate terms, contingencies, and timelines, and route for any required sign-off before countering or executing.
Redline and counter with the counterparty. Log each PSA version in the Counter History; the ball-in-court flips with every exchange until terms are locked.
Draft the purchase & sale agreement from the agreed LOI terms. Circulate the first draft and capture the PSA date.
